title: CHECKERBOARD VS. RED/BLACK CHECKERED - CHEAP LOOKING
text:
CHECKERBOARD VS. RED/BLACK CHECKERED - CHEAP LOOKING. Quilt is sewn all over with shiny silver thread that cheapens this quilt. The shiny silver thread glows during the day and at night in low-lighting making quilt look so very gaudy and disgusting. Thought this was plaid turns out it is like a checkerboard game board again with silver shiny thread stitching all over the quilt that glows and cheapens this quilt.

I hate this quilt and will never purchase anything again from Lakeside Collection.

product_metadata.title: Checkered Bed Quilt Set with Pillow Shams - Red - Full/Queen - 3 Pieces
features: Add a classic decorative accent to any bedroom with this checkered pattern bed quilt with shams. No matter the existing interior design, this quilt and shams will complement it.
The primitive, neutral color checker design gives any bedroom a vintage cabin spirit. Bring the set to the family lodge in the woods for a comfy cover to sleep over.
Made of gentle polyester, you can machine wash the quilt and shams when they get dirty. Let them air dry or dry gently and then fold away or place them back on the bed.
Keep this farmhouse accent quilt set for the bedroom in your own home or give it as a gift to family and friends. It is excellent for an autumn season gift for those who own cabin retreats.
Polyester with polyfill. Machine care. Set includes: Quilt - 2 Shams (1 with Twin) - Twin quilt: 68"W x 86"L - Full/Queen quilt: 90" sq. - King quilt: 106"W x 90"L
description: Give your bedroom a farmhouse look with this checkered bed quilt set that includes matching pillow shams. Hypoallergenic construction set features a quilting design that reduces snag and breaks of the fabric. The eye-catching checker design adds a farmhouse accent to any bedroom with ease. It is versatile for any season and truly complements the interior design of a bedroom or guest room at the family cabin or weekend lodge retreat. Included with the King size set is two shams in matching king size. When the set gets dirty or it is time to change out the bedding, simply machine wash it and hang dry it to preserve the aesthetic.
